Your toddler can look for the animals and wander the garden paths at their own pace. It is a calm morning that ends well before nap.

  • Pack a snack to share on the picnic shelter before you go.
  • Let them choose which way to walk and stay as long as they like.
  • Name one last animal to wave to, then head to the car.

Or swap in

  • 📖 Toddler Storytime, then Plummer Park

    Northeast Regional Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:05 am–10:30 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Toddler Storytime at Northeast Regional Library has books, songs and rhymes with movement, then they burn off energy at Plummer Park.

    • Sit near the front so they can see the pictures.
    • Bring a snack for the playground.

  • 🌳 Apex Nature Park

    Cary / Apex · 9 am–10:30 am

    Map · Free

    A quiet nature morning for exploring the greenway and looking for leaves, sticks and birds.

    • Bring a bag for treasures like leaves and acorns.
    • Pack a snack for the picnic shelter.

  • 🌳 Gill Street Park, then Family Storytime

    East Wake · 10 am–11 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Your toddler plays at Gill Street Park first, then settles in for Family Storytime at Zebulon Community Library with books, music and rhymes.

    • Let them run first so sitting for stories is easier.
    • Tell them the stories come next, then walk over together.

  • 📅 Pancakes & Pajamas, then Hillside Park

    W.D. Hill Recreation Center · Durham · 8:50 am–10:40 am

    Map · $1.50 for Durham residents, $6.50 for others · Sign-up needed

    Pancakes & Pajamas at W.D. Hill Recreation Center is a cozy pajama breakfast, then play at Hillside Park. A family needs to sign up first.

    • Wear pajamas and bring a jacket for the park.
    • Let them build their own pancake.

Nothing else fits that today.

  • 🌳 Rock Quarry Park, then Gobble Till You Wobble

    Durham · 10:30 am–12 pm

    Map · $1.35 for Durham residents, $5.85 for others · Sign-up needed

    Your toddler plays at Rock Quarry Park first, then joins Gobble Till You Wobble at Edison Johnson Rec Ctr for turkey day activities. A family needs to sign up first.

    • Let them burn off energy at the playground before going in.
    • Bring a snack and eat after the program, before the car ride home.

  • 📖 Family Storytime, then Garner Jaycee Park

    Southeast Regional Library · Raleigh · 9:20 am–10:50 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Family Storytime at Southeast Regional Library with songs and rhymes, then a playground stop at Garner Jaycee Park.

    • Bring a snack for the playground.
    • Tell them the slide is next as you leave the library.

  • 📖 Toddler Storytime, then Tyler Run Park

    Northeast Regional Library · North Raleigh / Wake Forest · 9:05 am–10:30 am

    Map · Free · Sign-up not listed

    Toddler Storytime at Northeast Regional Library has books, music and movement, then time to play at Tyler Run Park.

    • Sit close so they can join the songs.
    • Bring a snack for the park.

  • 🌳 Carpenter Park

    Cary / Apex · 9:30 am–10:45 am

    Map · Free

    A playground morning in Cary with a picnic shelter for a snack break.

    • Pack a snack for the picnic shelter.
    • Give a five-minute warning before leaving.
